title: Startup
summary: Time to start the runtime and print one line.
description: The program prints `ok` and exits. This measures process start-up, runtime initialisation and (for managed runtimes) module loading - the fixed cost paid by every other benchmark.
reveals: Binary start-up and runtime initialisation overhead.
caveat: Dominated by dynamic linking, container filesystem and the OS; not a measure of throughput. Excluded from aggregate speed scores.
